bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='link' AND step='preview' AND data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト' AND NOT (data ? 'shareCode') AND data::text LIKE '%一番目%';")" || exit 63
test "$count" = 1 || exit 81
echo LINK_TEST_DRAFT_BOUND=PASS
